net_match_interval.method: 95% paired bootstrap with both global review queues reselected
net_match_interval.sampling: Eligible sentences sampled with replacement within each domain at its observed count; both arms share each draw; empirical inverse-CDF percentiles of candidate minus baseline exact matches.

ranking: relation probability multiplied by the lesser predicted endpoint probability raised to the selected weight; rank one per sentence, then rank nominees across the cohort

selection.selection: Among positive weights, most exact development additions at the primary budget; tie to smaller weight. Zero is the independent confidence baseline.
